title: 1998 AMC 8 Problem 17
statement: In how many years, approximately, from \(1998\) will the population of Nisos be as much as Queen Irene has proclaimed that the islands can support?

solutions.text:
The maximal population is \(\dfrac{24{,}900}{1.5}=16{,}600.\) This is \(83\) times as much as the population in \(1998,\) so it would be about \(4\) triples from \(1998.\) That would be \(25\cdot 4=100\) years.

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Compute how many people the islands can support.
Compare the capacity with the population after each tripling.
